title: Kinematics of continuum planar grasping
summary: This paper presents an analytical framework to study the geometry arising when a soft continuum arm grasps a planar object. Both the arm centerline and the object boundary are modeled as smooth curves. The grasping problem is formulated as a kinematic boundary following problem, in which the object boundary acts as the arm's 'shadow curve'. This formulation leads to a set of reduced kinematic equations expressed in terms of relative geometric shape variables, with the arm curvature serving as the control input. An optimal control problem is formulated to determine feasible arm shapes that achieve optimal grasping configurations, and its solution is obtained using Pontryagin's Maximum Principle. Based on the resulting optimal grasp kinematics, a class of continuum grasp quality metrics is proposed using the algebraic properties of the associated continuum grasp map. Feedback control aspects in the dynamic setting are also discussed. The proposed methodology is illustrated through systematic numerical simulations.
tldr: The paper introduces an analytical framework for modeling the geometry and kinematics of a soft continuum arm grasping a planar object, treating the grasp as a boundary‑following problem, solving an optimal control problem via Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle, and defining grasp quality metrics from the continuum grasp map.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分析软连续体手臂抓取平面物体的几何与运动学框架，将抓取问题转化为边界跟踪问题，利用Pontryagin极大值原理求解最优抓取形态，并基于连续体抓取映射的代数属性提出抓取质量指标。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一个分析框架，用于研究软体连续体机械臂抓取平面物体时的几何形态。机械臂中心线和物体边界均被建模为光滑曲线。抓取问题被表述为运动学边界跟随问题，其中物体边界作为机械臂的"影曲线"。该表述导致一组以相对几何形状变量表示的简化运动方程，其中机械臂曲率作为控制输入。建立了最优控制问题以确定实现最优抓取构型的可行机械臂形状，并利用庞特里亚金最大值原理求解该问题。基于所得到的最优抓取运动学，提出了一类利用相关连续体抓取映射代数性质的连续体抓取质量度量指标。此外还讨论了动态环境下的反馈控制方面。通过系统数值仿真验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: Warm-Started Reinforcement Learning for Iterative 3D/2D Liver Registration
summary:
Registration between preoperative CT and intraoperative laparoscopic video plays a crucial role in augmented reality (AR) guidance for minimally invasive surgery. Learning-based methods have recently achieved registration errors comparable to optimization-based approaches while offering faster inference. However, many supervised methods produce coarse alignments that rely on additional optimization-based refinement, thereby increasing inference time.
  We present a discrete-action reinforcement learning (RL) framework that formulates CT-to-video registration as a sequential decision-making process. A shared feature encoder, warm-started from a supervised pose estimation network to provide stable geometric features and faster convergence, extracts representations from CT renderings and laparoscopic frames, while an RL policy head learns to choose rigid transformations along six degrees of freedom and to decide when to stop the iteration.
  Experiments on a public laparoscopic dataset demonstrated that our method achieved an average target registration error (TRE) of 15.70 mm, comparable to supervised approaches with optimization, while achieving faster convergence.
  The proposed RL-based formulation enables automated, efficient iterative registration without manually tuned step sizes or stopping criteria. This discrete framework provides a practical foundation for future continuous-action and deformable registration models in surgical AR applications.
tldr: A warm-started reinforcement learning approach for 3D CT to 2D laparoscopic video liver registration achieves similar target registration error to supervised methods but with faster convergence, enabling automated iterative alignment without manual step size or stopping criteria.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种温启动的强化学习方法，用于三维CT与二维腹腔镜视频的肝脏配准，实现了与监督方法相当的配准误差且收敛更快，实现了无需人工设定步长和停机准则的自动迭代对齐。
summary_zh: 术前CT与术中腹腔镜视频之间的配准在微创手术的增强现实(AR)导航中起着至关重要的作用。近年来，基于学习的方法已达到了与基于优化方法相当的配准误差，同时具有更快的推理速度。然而，许多有监督方法产生的是粗略对齐，需要额外的基于优化的细化，从而增加了推理时间。我们提出了一种离散动作强化学习(RL)框架，将CT到视频的配准表述为一个序贯决策过程。一个共享特征编码器从有监督姿态估计网络预热启动，以提供稳定的几何特征和更快的收敛速度，从CT渲染图像和腹腔镜帧中提取特征表示，而RL策略头学习在六个自由度上选择刚性变换并决定何时停止迭代。在公开腹腔镜数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法达到了15.70 mm的平均目标配准误差(TRE)，与有监督优化方法相当，同时实现了更快的收敛。所提出的基于强化学习的配准方法实现了自动化、高效的迭代配准，无需手动调整步长或停止标准。这一离散框架为外科AR应用中未来连续动作和可变形配准模型提供了实用的基础。
